observations: Manual/vibrating block making machine, often called an 'egg-layer' type.
Blue painted steel frame mounted on four wheels.
Red painted mold box and a red electric vibrator motor mounted on top.
Digital watermark 'OLA-TECH METAL FABRICATION SERVICES LTD' is present on both images.
Power cable is visible, indicating it is an electric-powered vibrator model.
The mold appears to be configured for two blocks at a time.

claims.evidence: The mold dimensions cannot be verified from the photos, though it is a double mold.

risks.risk: Electric vibrator motor may be burnt or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video clip of the machine plugged in and vibrating.
risks.if_unproven: as not working (scrap value for motor)

risks.risk: Mold may be warped or produce non-uniform blocks.
risks.proof: A photo of a finished block next to a carpenter's square or measuring tape.

risks.risk: Structural welds may be cracked or poorly executed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the primary load-bearing weld joints.

proof_requests: Video of the vibrator motor running.
Close-up photos of the internal surfaces of the mold.
Photo of the manufacturer's physical nameplate if one exists.
response.reason: The item is a standard locally fabricated block making machine. It can be priced as a functional unit with deductions for the unproven state of the motor and mold.
